source.caption: Maximum number of intermediates [r](m), m > 0 required to evaluate [r](0) per batch for 1, 3, 6 and 9 batches as L varies. Bolded values indicate that this number of batches obtains the minimum execution time for a kernel with angular momentum L.
source.transcription: Read from a 200 dpi render of PDF page 12, and diffed cell by cell against the PDF's text layer; the two reads agree in all 40 cells.

quantity.description: Largest number of intermediates [r](m), m > 0, that any one batch needs to evaluate its targets [r](0).

rows.name: L
rows.description: Total angular momentum of the [p|q] class.

columns.name: batches
columns.description: Number of batches the targets [r](0) are split into (Algorithm 4).

notes: Boys-function evaluation is excluded from these counts (Section 7.1).

Rows fall left to right with TWO EXCEPTIONS, both as printed and both deliberate in this transcription: at L = 7 the 6- and 9-batch values are 39 then 40 (a rise), and at L = 10 they tie at 95 and 95. Neither is treated as a misprint; do not regularise them.
Bold marks the batch count(s) with the fastest measured kernel at that L (A100). It is annotation, not data, and is not recorded here.
